# Marcelino Client (.NET) Instructions

- This workspace contains only the Windows desktop client port. Do not modify or copy files from the separate `BackupLAN` project unless explicitly requested.
- Use .NET 10 and WPF, following the existing solution and project structure.
- Preserve compatibility with the current NAS interfaces: SMB shares, the `.marcelinoSrv.json` status file, SSH, and backup/restore behavior.
- Keep changes focused and build the solution after code changes.
